LU-20876 efalnd: Return correct error on CQ create

The completion queue create error path returns the is-error predicate
instead of the actual negative error code.

Return the extracted error code.

Fixes: 0c773016d837 ("LU-18977 efalnd: Introduce AWS EFA Lustre network driver")
